entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production candidate 2D dinosaur onesie animation/model sheet for the private Little Weeps game. Reference image is Bluey's accepted animation sheet; preserve his exact recognizable face, muzzle, eye shapes, facial markings, rectangular proportions, cheerful personality and clean flat-color dark-outline illustration style. Draw Bluey actually WEARING a charming sewn dinosaur hooded onesie, not painted fur and not pasted geometric ornaments. Cozy leaf-green fabric over torso, sleeves, legs and feet, soft pale cream oval belly panel, fitted padded cuffs, a plush dinosaur tail replacing the exposed dog tail, cream soft triangular plates sewn down the hood/back/tail. A rounded dinosaur-head hood covers the dog ears and wraps around the face with a generous oval opening; Bluey's complete original eyes, eyebrows, cheek markings and muzzle remain visible. Hood has a friendly little dinosaur eye and rounded snout above the forehead; tiny soft cream teeth at hood edge. Thoughtful professional cartoon costume design, comfortable and cute, recognizable as Bluey in a dinosaur outfit. Green suit fabric is consistently green in every pose, pale cream accents, preserve all Bluey blue facial colors. Transparent 4-column x 4-row atlas exactly SIXTEEN separate full-body poses, consistent scale, generous gutters, each entire hood/tail/feet safely inside its cell, no labels, no text, no shadows, no background, no grid. Pose order row-major: row1 right three-quarter idle smiling; same idle blinking; gentle wave near hand; second gentle wave. Row2 and row3: eight small relaxed right-facing walking cycle phases from right-leg forward contact through passing/down/up to left-leg forward contact and back, subtle small arm swings, grounded feet; keep a right three-quarter face. Row4: seated on invisible bench with knees/feet forward; standing carrying-ready near hand at waist with no prop; playful dinosaur roar with mouth open and little claw hands lifted; second playful roar with arms a little wider. Keep character head/body sizes identical across poses, no exaggerated walk, no generic dinosaur replacing Bluey. All empty space must have true clean transparent alpha, no color speckles or fringe.
